0.msg: Look at these shabby old lights, #b#h0##k! These will never work for mood lighting. You've got to do something about this, #b#h0##k.

1.msg: I mean... they look fine to me?

2.msg: No. No, they do not. A perfect party needs perfect lighting, and this is FAR from perfect. How can anyone enjoy such an ill-lit party? Don't answer that, you clearly don't understand.

3.msg: Most importantly, my dress will only sparkle under perfect lighting, so this is non-negotiable. Now, listen up while I explain what you need to do.

4.msg: #b(She's using the lighting as an excuse. She just wants to stand out from the crowd.)#k

yes.0: We have some old #bCandles#k stashed away in a chest. Find them and bring them back so that I might arrange them fashionably.
yes.1: The ghosts in the mansion are carrying #bCandle Chest Keys#k. They're attracted to shiny things.
yes.2: Take the keys from the ghosts and drop them in front of the chest in the #bCentral Hall#k. The chest will open, just like that.
yes.3: I'll need at least five #bCandles#k for the arrangement I'm planning. That means you need to hop to it!
